purpose: Track Station Calyx doctrine, Work Order, runtime, and historical families by original canonical intent versus current runtime authority.
governing_premise: Canonical intent is not the same as current canonical authority.
authority_boundary: This registry classifies and recommends. It does not promote inactive systems, restart services, ingest archives, delete artifacts, or grant runtime authority.

entries.title: DOC_STATUS registry and stale active labels
entries.original_intent: Provide a machine-readable status layer so documentation hygiene and deprecated-doc gates could distinguish active, archived, deprecated, and forbidden material.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: The registry exists and all listed files exist, but many entries still carry February or April active labels that conflict with the newer reduction authority model.
entries.required_next_step: Run a focused doc-status reconciliation pass that preserves historical traceability while demoting stale active labels to support, historical, superseded, quarantined, or planned_not_exercised.

entries.title: Canonical Ops Index and Operational Doctrine stale wording
entries.original_intent: Give the operator a concise source of truth for governed operations, sunrise, audit discipline, and canonical control paths.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Sunrise/sunset and governed runtime are real, but older wording still overstates Bridge Overseer residency and treats audit as a singular truth source instead of part of a distributed evidence model.
entries.required_next_step: After doc-status reconciliation, update operator-facing wording so current core, support, quarantine, and distributed truth boundaries are explicit.

entries.title: Navigator/Triage, Energy Churn/CP9, and CP6/CP7 active loops
entries.original_intent: Provide cadence control, triage, energy/tuning advice, harmony, and drift signals to reduce Station entropy and guide CBO behavior.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Topology reports the loop families running and STATE reports navigator/triage values, but authority labels remain unknown and current operator value has not been narrowed.
entries.required_next_step: Run a focused loop-authority pass to decide whether each loop is core, support, historical, or removable from sunrise.

entries.title: Runtime singleton/multiplicity doctrine versus enforcement
entries.original_intent: Prevent silent multi-runtime drift and reconcile duplicate or ambiguous Station processes.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Topology observation and labeling are active; latest topology risk is LOW with no duplicates, but enforcement remains partial and not a complete singleton guarantee.
entries.required_next_step: Decide whether singleton doctrine remains binding; if yes, complete enforcement, otherwise simplify doctrine to observation-only.

entries.title: Agent ecology, COMPENDIUM, and CP role claims
entries.original_intent: Represent the Station crew, role ecology, and BloomOS substrate as named agents, copilots, and overseers.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Some loop roles are active; many named roles are historical, missing, conceptual, or advisory. Current docs can imply a larger operational crew than the runtime supports.
entries.required_next_step: Classify each named role as active runtime, support doctrine, historical/cultural, missing, or quarantined.

entries.title: Memory doctrine versus support-only continuity reality
entries.original_intent: Preserve operator and Station continuity across sessions, daily logs, curated memory, and future hot/warm memory architecture.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: MEMORY.md and daily notes are support/reference surfaces. No evidence supports MEMORY.md as runtime continuity authority or automatic archive ingestion.
entries.required_next_step: Keep MEMORY.md support-only, decide whether daily memory discipline should be completed or demoted, and prevent archive ingestion claims without explicit receipts.

entries.title: Calyx Mail, intent pipeline, and work-envelope spine
entries.original_intent: Provide structured intent, message, and execution-envelope pathways for governed work beyond direct chat.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Substantial code and tests exist, but the current operator path is governed /chat through CBO Core, Avatar Web, and Discord Gateway.
entries.required_next_step: Keep as noncanonical research/support until a future pass decides whether to rehabilitate or archive it.

entries.title: Swarm, worker lease, trace, and sandbox runtime claims
entries.original_intent: Create governed worker execution with leases, traceability, sandbox containment, and receipt bundles.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Code, tests, and phase receipts exist, but no current Station runtime execution path uses an active autonomous worker swarm.
entries.required_next_step: Leave noncanonical until the current core is stable and a separate implementation authorization exists.

entries.title: OpenClaw, Bridge Overseer, legacy Discord intake, and external paths
entries.original_intent: Support orchestration, external gateway integration, and historical Discord/OpenClaw pathways that helped bootstrap Station Calyx.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Bridge Overseer is not started by normal sunrise; legacy Discord and OpenClaw paths are refusal-gated or quarantined; external emitter gate is active.
entries.required_next_step: Preserve historical value while preventing any noncanonical path from implying active authority.

entries.title: Kalshi, weather, and market research layers
entries.original_intent: Explore market/weather research and decision-support artifacts under governed Station discipline.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Docs and tests exist, but the family is outside the reduced active core and has no current runtime role.
entries.required_next_step: Keep archived/historical until explicitly reauthorized; do not mix with core entropy-reduction work.

entries.title: Reduced core runtime and operator control plane
entries.original_intent: Provide the live Station workstation core: startup, shutdown, governed chat, local operator surfaces, and Discord transport.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Latest runtime checks pass, sunrise receipt is ok, topology risk is LOW, and no duplicate services were observed.
entries.required_next_step: Keep as the baseline authority while reducing surrounding doctrine entropy.

entries.title: Runtime truth, source authority, and confusion policy substrate
entries.original_intent: Make current objective, approved source roots, and uncertainty classification explicit so CBO does not guess silently.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Clarity status passes, active objective is active, source registry validates all five roots, and STATE exposes the policy.
entries.required_next_step: Use this registry and confusion policy as the governing reduction tool for subsequent family passes.

entries.title: Local read-only MCP support
entries.original_intent: Provide bounded local read-only access to approved Station roots for operator-authorized analysis and context review.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: Sunrise validates MCP readiness; approved roots include C:\Calyx_Terminal, C:\Calyx_Test_Temp, C:\Calyx_Parking, C:\Calyx_Federation_Inbox, and D:\Calyx_Data.
entries.required_next_step: Keep read-only and support-only; do not treat MCP as continuity authority or ingestion authorization.

entries.title: BloomOS, Constellation, Vault, and ritual/cultural doctrine
entries.original_intent: Define the symbolic, cultural, pedagogical, and long-horizon identity substrate around Station Calyx and BloomOS.
entries.current_runtime_evidence: The documents exist and may preserve meaning, but no current runtime implementation makes this family operational authority.
entries.required_next_step: Preserve as doctrine/culture unless a later pass maps a narrow subset into active runtime evidence.

focused_first_family.reason: It is the highest-confusion family because it can make stale or superseded docs appear active before the operator even reaches the newer canonical reduction artifacts.
focused_first_family.recommended_first_pass: Reconcile docs/DOC_STATUS_REGISTRY.json against docs/canonical/CALYX_DOCUMENT_STATUS_REGISTRY.md and the 2026-04-25 reconciliation audit, then emit a receipt. Do not rewrite every doc body in the same pass.
